_comment: Rule table v1.1 — adds consumer_care as optional for drugs_pharma (was absent in v1.0); textiles now requires net_quantity.

rules.description: MRP must be declared in full (inclusive of all taxes) in Indian rupees.

rules.declaration: Net Quantity / Net Weight / Net Volume
rules.description: Net quantity must be declared with standard unit (g, kg, ml, l, etc.).

rules.declaration: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
rules.description: Month and year of manufacture or packing must be declared.

rules.declaration: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name and Address
rules.description: Full name and complete address of manufacturer, packer, or importer.
Consumer care contact (phone/email) must be provided.

packaged_food.label: Packaged Food
packaged_food.notes: All 5 declarations mandatory under Schedule II.

packaged_commodity.label: Packaged Commodity (General)
packaged_commodity.notes: All 5 declarations mandatory under LM(PC) Rules 2011.

drugs_pharma.label: Drugs & Pharmaceuticals
drugs_pharma.notes: v1.1: consumer_care promoted to required (was optional in v1.0).

textiles.label: Textiles & Garments
textiles.notes: v1.1: net_quantity now required for textiles (was optional in v1.0).
